physics_goals.quote: to probe eV-scale sterile neutrinos by searching for neutrino oscillations over meter-long baselines
physics_goals.value: Search for eV-scale sterile neutrinos through antineutrino oscillations over metre-long baselines, and measure the 235U antineutrino spectrum from a highly enriched uranium reactor

summary.plain: A small antineutrino detector, a few metres from the compact core of a research reactor in Tennessee, used to test whether neutrinos oscillate into a hypothetical fourth "sterile" type and to measure the energy spectrum of antineutrinos from uranium-235 fission.
summary.technical: Segmented 4 t 6Li-doped liquid-scintillator antineutrino detector (11 x 14 segments) at 7-9 m from the highly enriched uranium core of the 85 MW High Flux Isotope Reactor, ORNL, under < 1 m.w.e. Searched for eV-scale sterile-neutrino disappearance by comparing IBD spectra between baselines, and measured the 235U antineutrino spectrum. Data taken March-October 2018.
